 About Ramon Abatti
 CountryBrazil
 Recorded matches176
 Available seasons2022 – 2025
 Competitions12
 Ramon Abatti Abel is a Brazilian referee with international projection who has gained recognition for his authority, physical preparation, and modern refereeing style. Born in Santa Catarina, he has been part of the CBF refereeing team for over a decade and was included in the FIFA international referees list in 2022.He is characterized by a balanced approach in his decisions, a tendency to maintain the pace of the game, and a calm management of tense situations. He has officiated key matches in Brasileirão, Copa do Brasil, and CONMEBOL tournaments such as Copa Sudamericana and Copa Libertadores.Statistically, Abatti is a referee who tends to show a moderate number of cards per game, although he does not hesitate to apply discipline when the intensity of the game requires it. In VAR, he has also had outstanding performances, being considered one of the most consistent profiles in current Brazilian refereeing.
